Ka baseen ni

The document of/by

Isra

Ezra

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka baseen ni Isra, hendue te sumpul red te Me baseen te Krunikas. Nahuhud kayi ka meyitenged te peg-uli te duma ne me Hudiyu ne naddakep diye te Babilunya, wey ka pegpalibed te keugpe wey pegsimba diye te Hirusalim. Nabaad seini te tatelu: 1/ Ka pegpeuli ni Siru ne Hari te Pirsya te seeye se hun-a ne punduk te me Hudiyu ne naddakep ne diyad te Babilunya. 2/ Ka pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu wey ka peghalad kayi, wey ka pegpalibed te pegsimba te Manama diye te Hirusalim. 3/ Ka peg-uli diye te Hirusalim te seeye se lein e man-e ne punduk te me Hudiyu ne impanguluwan ni Isra, ka sabeka ne mangngateu te Balaud te Manama. Nakabulig sikandin te me Israilita te pegpalibed te me tuluuwen wey nabatasan dan, eyew kene dan egkeengkeran ka pegsimba te malehet ne Manama.

The document of/by Isra, (is) like an addition to The documents of Krunikas. It's told here about the returning_home of some of the Hudiyus from being_captured there in Babilunya, and the returning of the living and worshiping there in Hirusalim. This is divided into three: 1/ The sending_ of Siru the king of Pirsya _to_return_home of those first group of Hudiyus from being_taken_captives that are already in Babilunya. 2/ The redoing of building of the temple and the dedication of it, and the returning of the worshiping of God (MS Manama) in Hirusalim. 3/ The returning_home again to Hirusalim of those different group of Hudiyus that were led by Isra, one skilled in the Law of God. He was_able_to_help the Israilitas in returning to their beliefs and customs, so_that the worshiping of the true God wouldn't be_forsaken by_them.

Ka pegpeuli ni Hari Siru te me Hudiyu

The sending_home of the Hudiyus by King Siru

11 [xr]Te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari ni Siru te Pirsya, impuwasan ka suman-suman din te Magbebaye ne Manama eyew egpakasulat te sabeka ne pegpataha te intiru ne migharian din. Neyitabu seini eyew egkatuman ka lalag te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi ki prupita Hirimiyas.

11 [xr]In the first year of the kinging by Siru in/of Pirsya, his thinking was_opened by the Lord God in_order to write one announcement to his entire kingdom. It happened so_that the word of the Lord God by_means of the prophet Hirimiyas would_be_fulfilled.

2 [xr]Seini ka insulat ni Siru ne Hari te Pirsya: “Ka Magbebaye ne Manama ne iyan ka Manama ne diye te langit, ka migbehey keddi te langun ne migharian kayi te kalibutan. In-alam a nikandin te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu para kandin diye te Hirusalim, ne sakup te Huda. 3 Sikaniyu se langun ne keet-etawan din, egkaayun e ne eg-uli diye te Hirusalim. Balbalawi niyu te pegpasasindeg ka timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil ne insimba diye te Hirusalim. Egdumaan kew perem langun te Manama niyu. 4 Ka minsan hentew te keet-etawan din ne naddakep dengan ne egkeilangan te bulig eyew egpekeuli, keilangan ne ka me sumbaley rin, egbehey kandin te pelata, bulawan, me kasangkapan, me ayam, wey egbehey pad man-e sikandan te duma ne me dasag para te timplu te Manama diye te Hirusalim.”

2 [xr]This is what_was_written by Siru the king of Pirsya: “The Lord God who is the God there in heaven/sky, was the (one who) gave me all the kingdoms here in the world. I was_chosen by_him for redoing building (LIT causing_to_stand) a/the temple for him there in Hirusalim, under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. 3 You(pl) all who (are) his people, you(pl) may return_home(pl) to Hirusalim. Redo(pl) standing_up the temple of the Lord God, the God of Israil that is worshiped in Hirusalim. May your(pl) God be with you(pl) all. 4 Whoever of his people that was_captured(pl) before who needs help in_order to_be_able_to_return_home, it's_necessary that his/her neighbors, give him silver, gold, furniture/utensils, domestic_animals, and they will_ also still _give other gifts for the temple of God there in Hirusalim.”

5 Ne ka me pangulu te me pamilya[fn] ne me kabuhalan ni Huda wey ni Binhamin duma te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita, lagkes seeye se langun ne impuwasan te Manama ka me suman-suman, migpangandam e ne eggendiye te Hirusalim eyew te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 6 Ne imbehayan sikandan te me sumbaley ran te me kasangkapan ne pelata, bulawan, me kasangkapan ne keilanganen, me ayam, me mahal ne kasangkapan, wey duma pad ne dasag para te timplu.

5 And the leaders of the families[fn] which (are) the descendants of Huda and of Binhamin along_with the sacrificers and the Libitas, including all those who_ God _opening the thinking(pl), prepared to go to Hirusalim in_order to redo standing the temple of the Lord God. 6 And they were_given by their neighbors utensils of silver, gold, needed utensils, domestic_animals, expensive furniture/utensils, and still other gifts for the temple.

7 Impeuli degma ni Hari Siru ka me kasangkapan te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne diye te Hirusalim ne in-uyan ni Hari Nibukadnisar ne intahu din diye te timplu te me diyus-diyus din. 8 Ne impabehey e seini ni Siru ne Hari te Pirsya diye ki Mitridatis ne talaggen-gen te seleppi. Ne inseel rin e seini wey imbehey rin e ki Sisbasar ne gubirnadur te Huda. 9 Ne seini ka kasuluhan te me kasangkapan: tatelu ne pulu (30) ne bulawan ne pelenggana, sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne pelata ne pelenggana, daruwa ne pulu wey siyam (29) ne kasangkapan ne pelata, 10 tatelu ne pulu (30) ne bulawan ne yahung, 410 ne pelata ne yahung, wey sabeka ne libu (1,000) te duma pad ne me kasangkapan.

7 King Siru also returned the utensils of the temple of the Lord God which is in Hirusalim that were_taken by King Nibukadnisar that he had put in the temple of his (false)_gods. 8 And Siru the king of Pirsya had_ this _given to Mitridatis the holder of money. And he counted it and gave it to Sisbasar the governor of Huda. 9 And this is the count of the utensils: thirty (30) gold basins, one thousand (1,000) silver basins, twenty-nine (29) silver utensils, 10 thirty (30) gold bowls, 410 silver bowls, and one thousand (1,000) other utensils.

11 Migginguma te 5,400[fn] ka langun ne kasangkapan ne bulawan wey pelata. Impanguyan seini enni Sisbasar wey te duma te peg-uli dan diye te Hirusalim puun te pegdakep wey peg-uyan kandan diye te Babilunya.

11 All the gold and silver utensils came to 5,400.[fn] These were carried(pl) by Sisbasar and_company and others on their returning_home to Hirusalim who had been_captured and taken to Babilunya.

Ka peggimu te iyam ne altar

The making of a new altar

31 Te igkapitu e ne bulan,[fn] te nenekeugpe e ka me Israilita diye te me lungsud dan, miglibulung sikandan diye te Hirusalim. 2 [xr]Ne si Hiswi ne anak ni Husadak wey ka me duma rin ne me talagpanubad, wey si Sirubabil ne anak ni Salatiil, wey ka me karumaan din, migbunsud e ka egbalew-balew te altar te Manama te Israil eyew egtutungan te igmanubad dan sumale te nasulat te Balaud ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Manama. 3 [xr]Ne impasasindeg dan ka altar diye te natahuan dengan kayi minsan nenaaldek sikandan te mahinged diye. Ne migtutung e sikandan te igmanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama tagse maselem wey te marusilem.[fn] 4 [xr]Ne intuman dan ka Sahakeen diye te me Leeb sumale ke nekey ka nasulat, wey migtutung sikandan te igmanubad sumale te ingkeilangan ne igpanubad te tagse aldew te seini ne Sahakeen. 5 [xr]Pegkeimpus dutu, impabulus dan ka pegtutung te igmanubad te tagse maselem wey marusilem, wey ka peghalad te timpu te Iyam ne Bulan,[fn] wey ka langun ne sahakeen ne suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne migbehey degma ka me etew te me dasag ne igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 6 Te an-anayan ne aldew te igkapitu ne bulan, migbunsud e sikandan ka migmanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama minsan ware pad nabunsuri ka pabunsuran te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama.

31 On the seventh month,[fn] when the Israilitas were living(pl) in their towns, they all gathered there in Hirusalim. 2 [xr]And Hiswi the child of Husadak along_with his companions the sacrificers, and Sirubabil the child of Salatiil, and his relatives, began to redo the altar of the God of Israil so_that (it_would_be) a burning_place for their sacrifices(pl) according to what_is_written in the Law of Muwisis the servant of God. 3 [xr]And they just built the altar where_(it)_had_been_placed before even though they were_afraid of the local_people there. And they burned sacrifices to the Lord God each morning and evening.[fn] 4 [xr]And they fulfilled the Feast in Shelters according to what_is_written, and they burned their sacrifices according to what_needed to_be_sacrificed each day. 5 [xr]When that was_finished, they continued the burning of sacrifices each morning and night, and the offering at the time of the New Moon,[fn] and of all the feasts that were commanded by the Lord God. And the people also gave gifts to sacrifice to the Lord God. 6 On the first day of the seventh month, they began sacrificing(pl) to the Lord God even though the foundation of the temple of the Lord God wasn't yet started.

Ka pegbalew-balew te timplu

The redoing of the temple

7 Sikan naa, imbayaran dan te pelata ne seleppi ka me talagperi te batu wey ka me talagbebaley. Imbehayan dan degma ka me matig-Sidun wey ka me matig-Tiru te egkakeen, egkeinum, wey te mentika, eyew eg-uyan sikandan te kayu ne sidar ne egpuun te Libanun. Ne diye dan seeye ipabaye te dahat te Hupa sumale te pegtuhut ni Siru ne Hari te Pirsya.

7 So then, they paid silver money to the splitters of stone and the builders. The (ones) from_Sidun and the (ones) from_Tiru were_ also _given food, drink, and cooking_oil, so_that they could_bring cedar trees from Libanun. And they sent these via the sea at Hupa according_to the permission of Siru the king of Pirsya.

8 Migbunsud sikandan te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu te igkarangeb ne bulan te igkarangeb ne leg-un te pegginguma ran diye te Hirusalim. Ne migbulig si Sirubabil ne anak ni Salatiil wey si Hiswi ne anak ni Husadak, duma te langun ne duma ran ne me talagpanubad, me Libita, wey te langun ne nekeuli diye te Hirusalim puun te pegkarakep. Ne mig-alam sikandan te me Libita ne puun te daruwa ne pulu (20) se idad wey subla pad, eyew iyan egmandu te egtrabahu te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama. 9 Ne naalam ensi Hiswi duma te anak din ne me lukes wey te karumaan din, wey ensi Kadmiil duma te anak din ne me lukes, ne me kabuhalan langun ni Hudabiyas.[fn] Sikandan ka migmandu te egtrabahu te timplu te Manama, wey migbulig degma kandan ka me kabuhalan wey me karumaan ni Hinadad ne me Libita degma.

8 They started redoing standing the temple in the second month of the second year of their arrival there in Hirusalim. Sirubabil the child of Salatiil and Hiwsi child of Husadak, along_with all their companions who were sacrificers, Libitas, and all who had returned_home(pl) to Hirusalim from being captured helped. And they chose Libitas from twenty (20) years old and greater, in_order to govern (those who) work at the temple of the Lord God. 9 And Hiswi along_with his male children and his relatives, and Kadmiil along_with his male children, that were all descendants of Hudabiyas[fn] were_chosen. They were the (ones who) governed the (ones who) work at the temple of God, and the descendants and relatives of Hinadad who were also Levites helped also.

10 [xr]Te imbunsuran e te me talagbebaley ka pabunsuranan te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama, migparani e ka me talagpanubad ne migsaluub te malayat ne me kumbale dan ne migpanguyan te me trumpita. Ne migparani degma ka me Libita ne kabuhalan ni Asap ne migpanguyan te putew ne basalan eyew te pegdeyrey te Magbebaye ne Manama, sumale te insuhu ni Dabid ne Hari te Israil dengan. 11 [xr]Ne migpasubsubaley sikandan ka eg-ulahing te pegdeyrey wey pegpasalamat te Magbebaye ne Manama ne miggenendue,

10 [xr]When the builders had begun the foundation of the temple of the Lord God, the sacrificers approached dressed in their long clothes and carrying(pl) trumpets. And the Libitas who were descendants of Asap also approached and carried(pl) iron gongs in_order for praising the Lord God, according to what_ Dabid the king of Israil _had_commanded before. 11 [xr]And they replaced_each_other(pl) in singing for praising and thanking the Lord God saying,

“Meupiya ka Magbebaye ne Manama

“The Lord God is good

su ka geyinawa rin te Israil kene egkabalbalawan.”

because his love for Israil is unchangeable.”

Ne migmanguleyi te meemen ka langun ne etew te pegdeyrey te Magbebaye ne Manama, tenged su nabunsuran e ka pabunsuranan te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama.12 Piru masulug ka me buyag e ne talagpanubad, me Libita, wey me pangulu te me pamilya ne nakakita te an-anayan ne timplu. Migsinehew[fn] sikandan te meemen te pegkakita ran te nakatahu e ka pabunsuranan te iyam ne timplu, piru masulug degma ka migmanguleyi te pegkahale. 13 Ne kenad egkeilaan ka laheng te pegkuleyi te kahale wey ka laheng te pegsinehew, tenged su amana ne mahulub ka me etew wey egkarineg ka me laheng dan diye te mariyu.

And the people shouted(pl) loudly in praising the Lord God, because the foundation of the temple of the Lord God had been_started.12 But the old sacrificers, Libitas, and leaders of the families who saw the first temple were many. They cried[fn] loudly when they saw that the foundation of the new temple had been_placed, but many also shouted(pl) with happiness. 13 And the people couldn't recognize the sound of shouting for joy and the sound of crying, because the people were_ very _noisy and their voices could be heard from afar.

Ka pegbalabag te pegbalew-balew te timplu

The preventing of the redoing of the temple

41 Nanengnengan te me kuntere te me kabuhalan ni Huda wey ni Binhamin ne seeye se nekeuli puun te pegkarakep, egbalew-balew e egpasasindeg te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil. 2 [xr]Purisu, nangendiye sikandan ki Sirubabil wey diye te me pangulu te me pamilya, wey migkahi, “Pabuliha key nikaniyu te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu su migpamakey key ma degma te Manama iling kaniyu wey mighalad key degma kandin puun pad te timpu ni Isarhadun ne Hari te Asirya ne iyan mig-uyan kanami kayi.”

41 The enemies of the descendants of Huda and of Binhamin heard that the (ones who) had_returned_home from being_captured, were redoing building the temple of the Lord God, the God of Israil. 2 [xr]Therefore, they went(pl) to Sirubabil and to the leaders of the descendants of the families, and said, “Let(pl)_ us(excl) _help in redoing building the temple because we(excl) also serve God like you(pl) and we(excl) also offered to him from the time of Isarhadun the king of Asiriya who was the (one who) brought us(excl) here.”

3 Piru ingkahiyan sikandan enni Sirubabil, ni Hiswi, wey te duma ne pangulu te me pamilya te Israil, “Ware labet niyu te pegpasasindeg te timplu para te Manama ney. Sikanami re ka egbalew-balew egpasasindeg kayi para te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil, sumale te insuhu kanami ni Siru ne Hari te Pirsya.”

3 But they were_told by Sirubabul, Hiswi, and other leaders of the families of Israil, “You(pl) have_no involvement in building the temple for our(excl) God. Just we(excl) will_build it for the Lord God, the God of Israil, according to what_was_commanded to_us(excl) by Siru the king of Pirsya.”

4 Sikan naa ka impakannekalan te me mahinged te seeye ne inged ne egkaawaan te kabagget ka me matig-Huda, wey inninaaldek dan ka me matig-Huda eyew kene egpakapabulus ka egbalew-balew te timplu, 5 wey migsuul sikandan te me talagtambag eyew te pegbalabag te planu ran. Inggimu ran seini te langun ne timpu ne si Siru pad ka Hari te Pirsya taman te iyan e Hari si Daryu.

4 That's why the local_people of that place strove that the encouragement of the (ones) from_Huda be_lost_from_(them), and they frightened the (ones) from_Huda so_that the redoing of the temple could_ not _continue, 5 and they paid advisors in_order_for blocking their plan. They did this for all the time that Siru was the king of Pirsya until Daryu became king.

Ka pegbalabag te pegbalew-balew te Hirusalim

The blocking of the redoing of Hirusalim

6 Peglihad te masulug ne me leg-un, te pegbunsud te peghari ni Aswiru, migsusulat ka seeye ne me etew te pegbayung meyitenged te keet-etawan te Huda wey te Hirusalim.

6 After the passing of many years, at the beginning of the kinging by Aswiru, those people wrote accusing concerning the people of Huda and of Hirusalim.

7 Ne minsan te si Artasirsis e ka Hari te Pirsya, migsusulat ded diye te kandin ensi Bislam, si Mitridatis, si Tabiil, wey ka me duma ran. Nasulat seini te Aramayik ne linalahan wey inluwas seini diye te Hari.

7 And even when Artasirsis was the king of Pirsya, Bislam, Mitridatis, Tabiil, and their companions wrote to him. This was_written in the Aramayik language and it was interpreted for the king.

8 Ne migsusulat degma meyitenged te Hirusalim si Rihum ne gubirnadur te Samarya, wey si sikritari Simsay te igpeendiye ki Hari Artasirsis:

8 And governor Rihum of Samarya, and secretary Simsay also wrote concerning Hirusalim to_send to King Artasirsis:

9 “Ka seini ne sulat, egpuun ki gubirnadur Rihum, ki sikritari Simsay wey te me duma ran, me talewukum, te duma ne upisyal, wey te me matig-Irik, me matig-Babilunya, me matig-Susa ne diye te tane te Ilam, 10 lagkes ka duma ne keet-etawan ne indelrel te mabantug wey talahuren ne si Asurbanipal, wey diye din e ipeugpe te me siyudad te Samarya, wey diye te duma ne me inged kayi te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis.”

9 “This letter, comes from governor Rihum, from secretary Simsay and their companions, judges, from other officials, and from the (ones) from_Irik, from_Babilunya, from_Susa there in the land of Ilam, 10 including other people that were_driven_away by the respected and honored Asurbanipal, and made_ by_him _to_live in the cities of Samarya, and in other places here on the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River.”

11 Miggenendue ka sulat ne impeuyan dan: “Mahal ne Hari Artasirsis, egpangemusta key se me suluhuanen nu ne keet-etawan ne nangugpe kayi te prubinsya ne talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis.

11 The letter that they sent went_like_this: “Honored King Artasirsis, we(excl) your(sg) servants that (are) the people who live here in the province on the opposite_bank of the River Iyupratis greet (you).

12 “Mahal ne Hari, egkeupian key ne egkanengnengan nu ne ka me Hudiyu ne nekeuli kayi, diyad e te Hirusalim. Egbalbalawan dan e man-e te egpasasindeg seini se masinupaken wey mareet ne siyudad. Mahaan dan e egkeimpusi ka peggimu te alad ne matikang wey makepal su neimpusan dan man e te eg-ayad-ayad ka pabunsuranan kayi. 13 Ne mahal ne Hari, emun ke egkeimpusan dan e te egbalew-balew egpasasindeg ka siyudad wey ka me alad ne matikang wey makepal, kenad sikandan egbayad te buhis wey te duma pad ne bayaranen, wey egdeisek e ka seleppi te migharian. 14 Ne kuntee, tenged su matinumanen key ma ne me sakup nu,[fn] kene key egkeupian ne egtengteng te Hari ne egkeyilawan. Sikan naa, insulatan ney sikeykew eyew egpakanengneng ka kayi, 15 su eyew due egkeyimu ne pegsusi te sinulat te me kaap-apuan nu. Te seini ne sinulat, egkanengnengan nu ne amana ne masinupaken ka nangugpe te siyudad ne Hirusalim, nakasamuk te me Hari wey te me prubinsya, wey migribildi puun pad dengan. Sikan naa ka nahuhus ka seini ne siyudad. 16 Impataha ney sikeykew ne emun ke egkeimpusan e man-e te egbalew-balew egpasasindeg ka siyudad wey ka me alad, kene kad e degma egpakamandu te prubinsya ne kayi te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis.”

12 “Honored king, we(excl) want you(sg) to know that the Hudiyus that returned here, are there in Hirusalim. They are reworking again standing the rebellious and bad/evil city. They will_ soon _finish the making of a fence that's tall and thick because they have already finished repairing the foundation. 13 And honored king, if they finish redoing building the city and the tall and thick walls, they won't pay tax and other payment(s), and the money of the kingdom will_decrease. 14 And now/today, because we(excl) are your(sg) faithful workers,[fn] we(excl) don't want to look_at the king that's shamed. So then, we(excl) wrote you(sg) so_that you(sg) would_know_about this, 15 so_that there will_be_an investigation concerning the record of your(sg) ancestors. In this record, you(sg) will_know that those_who_live in the city of Hirusalim are very rebellious, disturbing kings and provinces, and rebelling since long ago. That's why this city was_demolished. 16 We(excl) are_informing you(sg) that if/when the city and fences get_finished again in redoing building, you(sg) will_ no_longer _be_able_to_rule of the province on the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River.”

17 Ne seini ka tabak te Hari te sulat ne impeuyan dan:

17 And this is the answer of the king to the letter that_ they _had_sent:

“Egpangemusta a ki gubirnadur Rihum, ki sikritari Simsay, wey te duma ran ne matig-Samarya, wey te intiru ne prubinsya ne due te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis.

“I greet governor Rihum, secretary Simsay, and their companions from_Samarya, and the entire province there on the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River.

18 “Ne kuntee, nabase e naay-ayari ka impeuyan niyu ne sulat wey naluwas seini te linalahan ku. 19 Purisu, impasusi kud wey nanengnengan ku ne ka nangugpe te seini ne siyudad, egkuntere te me Hari puun pad dengan, wey nabatasan dan ka pegsupak wey pegsukul. 20 Ne nanengnengan ku degma ne due mabantug ne me Hari te Hirusalim ne iyan egsukut te buhis, wey te duma pad ne bayaranen. Sikandan ka migmandu te intiru ne prubinsya ne due te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis. 21 Sikan naa, himu kew te sabeka ne suhu te pegpasanggel te himu te me etew, eyew kene egpakapabulus ka pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te seini ne siyudad taman te egsuhu ad e. 22 Kene niyu naa seini balahara su eyew kene egkareetan ka migharian ku.”

18 “And now, the letter that you(pl) sent was carefully read and it was translated to my language. 19 Therefore, I had_(it)_investigated and I found_out that those_who_live in this city, went_against the kings since long_ago, and their custom is disobeying and contending. 20 And I also found_out that there were powerful kings of Hirusalim who requested_payment of tax, and of other payments. They reigned_over the entire province there on the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River. 21 So then, make(pl) a (LIT one) command to stop the people's work, so_that the redoing building this city can't_continue until I command. 22 Don't(pl) ignore this so_that my reigning isn't destroyed.”

23 Te nabase e ka sulat ni Hari Artasirsis diye te tangkaan enni gubirnadur Rihum, ni sikritari Simsay, wey te duma ran, miglambunus e sikandan miggendiye te Hirusalim wey impehes dan pasanggela ka me Hudiyu.
