24 [xr]And like what_happened before, the making of the temple of God was_stopped in Hirusalim until the second year of the kinging by Daryu of/in Pirsya.

Ka pegpabulus te pegbalew-balew te timplu

The continuing of the redoing of the temple

51 [xr]Ne kuntee, ka me prupita ne si Hagiyu wey si Sakariyas ne kabuhalan ni Idu, insuhu te Manama te Israil te pegpangguhud te lalag din diye te me Hudiyu ne diye te Huda wey Hirusalim. 2 [xr]Seeye naa, migbunsud e man-e ensi Sirubabil ne anak ni Salatiil wey si Hiswi ne anak ni Husadak ka egbalew-balew egpasasindeg te timplu te Manama ne diye te Hirusalim, wey imbulihan sikandan te seeye se daruwa ne prupita te Manama.

51 [xr]And now/today, the prophets Hagiyu and Sakariyas the descendant of Idu, were commanded by the God of Israil to story the his word to the Hudiyus that were there in Huda and Hirusalim. 2 [xr]So then, Sirubabil the child of Salatiil and Hiswi the child of Husadak started again the redoing building of the temple of God there in Hirusalim, and they were_helped by those two prophets of God.

3 Te seeye ne timpu, si Tatinay ne gubirnadur te prubinsya diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, wey si Sitarbusinay, duma te me duma ran, nangendiye te kandan wey migkahi, “Hentew ka migsuhu kaniyu te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg wey peg-impus te seini ne timplu?” 4 Ne mig-inse pad man-e sikandan, “Hentew ka me ngaran te me etew ne migtrabahu te seini ne timplu?” 5 Piru imbantayan te Manama ka me igbuyag te me Hudiyu, purisu, ware pad migbalabag te pegbalew-balew te timplu ka me upisyal te Pirsya taman te egpakasusulat e sikandan ki Hari Daryu wey egkarawat dan e ka tabak din. 6 Seini ka tahu te sulat ne impeuyan ni gubirnadur Tatinay, wey ni Sitarbusinay, wey te me duma ran ne me upisyal te prubinsya diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis: 7 “Egpangemusta key keykew Mahal ne Hari Daryu.

3 At that time, Tatinay the governor of the province there in the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River, and Sitarbusinay, along_with their companions, went to them and said, “Who gave you(pl) order to redo building and finishing this temple?” 4 And they also asked, “Who (are) the names of the people working in/on this temple?” 5 But God was guarding the elders of the Hudiyus, therefore, the officials of Pirsya didn't yet block the redoing of the temple until they could_write to King Daryu and they could_receive his answer. 6 This is the content of the letter that was_sent by governor Tatinay, and by Sitarbusinay, and by their companions officials of the province there in the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River: 7 “We(excl) greet you(sg) Honored King Daryu.

8 “Keilangan ne egkanengnengan nu Mahal ne Hari ne miggendiye key te prubinsya te Huda, diye te impasasindehan te timplu te mabantug ne Manama. Ne nakita ney ne imbalbalawan seini pasasindeha ne iyan inggamit ka derakel ne me batu, wey intangenan e te me kayu ka me alabat. Nakapabulus ka seini ne himu pinaahi te peglasey-lasey ran, sikan naa, migmasiyapat ka pegpasasindeg.

8 “It's_necessary that you(sg) know Great King that we(excl) went_there to the province of Huda, there to the building of the temple of the honored God. And we(excl) saw that this is being redone built and what_is_being_used are large stones/rocks, and wood attached to the walls. This work has continued by_means_of their exertion, so then, (it's) quickly being_built.

9 “Ne mig-insaan ney ka me igbuyag te miggenendue, ‘Hentew ka migsuhu kaniyu te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg wey peg-impus te seini ne timplu?’ 10 Mig-insaan ney degma sikandan te me ngaran dan eyew igpakapanengneng ney keykew ka me ngaran te migmangulu kandan.

9 “And we(excl) asked the elders going_like_this, ‘Who gave you(pl) order to redo building and finishing this temple?’ 10 We(excl) also asked them their names in_order that we(excl) could_inform you(sg) of the names of (those who) lead(pl) them.

11 “Ne seini ka tabak dan kanami, ‘Me suluhuanen key te Manama te langit wey tane, wey egbalbalawan ney te egpasasindeg ka timplu ne inggimu wey in-impusan te mabantug ne Hari te Israil te dengan ne timpu. 12 [xr]Piru tenged te impeyibelu te kaap-apuan ney ka Manama ne diye te langit, imbehey rin e sikandan diye ki Nibukadnisar ka matig-Kaldiya ne Hari te Babilunya. Ne indereetan ni Nibukadnisar ka seini ne timplu wey impandakep ka keet-etawan wey impanguyan diye te Babilunya. 13 [xr]Piru te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari ni Siru diye te Babilunya, migsuhu sikandin ne keilangan ne egbalbalawan te egpasasindeg ka timplu te Manama. 14 Ne seeye se bulawan wey pelata ne me kasangkapan te timplu te Manama ne ingkuwa ni Nibukadnisar puun te timplu diye te Hirusalim wey in-uyan diye te timplu te Babilunya, impakuwa ni Hari Siru wey imbehey diye ki Sisbasar ne in-alam din ne gubirnadur te Huda. 15 Ne inlalahan ni Hari Siru si Sisbasar, “Uyana nu seini se me kasangkapan wey itahu nu diye te timplu ne diye te Hirusalim, wey pabalbalawi nu te egpasasindeg ka timplu te Manama diye te nasasindehan ded dengan kayi.” 16 Sikan naa ka miggendiyad si Sisbasar te Hirusalim wey intahu din e ka me pabunsuranan te timplu te Manama. Ne puun te seeye ne aldew taman kuntee, migpabulus ka peggimu te timplu piru ware pad neimpusi.’

11 “And this was their answer to_us(excl), ‘We(excl) are servants of the God of heaven/sky and earth, and we(excl) are redoing building the temple that was_made and finished by the powerful king of Israil at a past time. 12 [xr]But due to our(excl) ancestors making_angry the God there in heaven/sky, he gave them to Nibukadnisar the (one) from_Kaliya who is king in/of Babilunya. And Nibukadnisar destroyed this temple and captured(pl) the people and took (them) there to Babilunya. 13 [xr]But in the first year of the kinging by Siru there in Babilunya, he commanded that it's_necessary to redo making the temple of God. 14 And those gold and silver utensils from the temple of God that were_taken by Nibukadnisar from the temple in Hirusalim and taken to the temple in Babilunya, King Siru had_(them)_fetched and (they) were_given to Sisbasar whom he chose to be governor of Huda. 15 And King Siru said to Sisbasar, “Take(sg) these utensil and place(sg) (them) in the temple at Hirusalim, and get_redone(sg) the building of the temple of God there in_the_place_where_it_stood before.” 16 So then Sisbasar went_there to Hirusalim and he placed the foundations of the temple of God. And from that day until now, the making of the temple continues but (it's) still not finished.’

17 “Ne kuntee, emun ke igkahale seini te Hari, ipasusi nu ka me sinulat te me Hari diye te Babilunya te pegnengneng ke malehet naan iya ne migsuhu si Hari Siru ne egpabalbalawan te egpasasindeg ka timplu te Manama diye te Hirusalim. Ne panengnenga key ke nekey ka suman-suman te Hari meyitenged kayi.”

17 “And now/today, if this pleases the king, get_investigated(sg) the letters of the king there in Babilunya to find_out if it's indeed correct that King Siru commanded that the temple of God there in Hirusalim be redone (in) building. And have_ us(excl) _informed what the thinking of the king is concerning this.”

Ka pegkakita te suhu ni Hari Siru

The finding of the command of Siru

61 Sikan naa ka migsuhu e si Hari Daryu ne egsusiyen ka me sinulat ne diye te tahuanan kayi diye te Babilunya. 2 Ne diye nakita ka eglulunen ne baseen te Ikbatana, ka iney ne siyudad te prubinsya te Midiyan, wey kayi nasulat ka seini ne suhu:

61 That's why King Daryu ordered/commanded that the letters there in the storage_place here in Babilunya be_checked_out. 2 And a rolled_up document was found there in Ikbatana, the capital (LIT mother) city of the province of Midiyan, and there_was_written this command:

3 “Te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari ni Siru, miggimu sikandin te suhu ne egbalbalawan te egpasasindeg ka timplu te Manama diye te natahuan dengan kayi diye te Hirusalim eyew diye eghalad wey egtutung te igmanubad. Ne keilangan ne siyam ne pulu (90) ne mitrus ka kalayat kayi wey siyam ne pulu (90) degma ne mitrus ka kaluag, 4 wey ka tagse tatelu ne impeg-ampew ne derakel ne me batu, eg-ampawan te kayu. Ne ka eggastuwen ne seleppi, diye eg-angaya te tahuanan te seleppi te Hari. 5 Ne ka bulawan wey ka pelata ne me kasangkapan te timplu te Manama ne in-uyan ni Hari Nibukadnisar diye te Babilunya, keilangan ne ig-uli ded diye te nenatahuan kayi diye te timplu te Hirusalim.”

3 “In the first year of the kinging by Siru, he made a command to redo to build the temple of God there to Hirusalim where_(it)_had_been_placed so_that there (they could) offer and burn sacrifices. And it is necesssary that the length of it is ninety (90) meters and the width is also ninety (90) meters, 4 and each three large stones/rocks piled_on_top_of_each_other, will_have wood placed_on_top. And the monetary expenses, will_be_taken from the storage_place of money of the king. 5 And the gold and silver utensils in the temple of God that were_taken by Nibukadnisar to Babilunya that were_from the temple in Hirusalim, should be_returned to the temple in Hirusalim where_ (it) _had_been_placed.”

Ka suhu ni Hari Daryu ne igpabulus ka himu

The command of King Daryu to continue the work

6 “Ne kuntee, sikeykew Tatinay ne gubirnadur te prubinsya ne due te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, Sitarbusinay, wey te duma niyu ne me upisyal te prubinsya ne talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis:

6 “And now, you(sg) Tatinay governor of the province there on the opposite_bank of the River Iyupratis, Sitarbusinay, and your(pl) companion officials there in the province on the opposite_bank of the River Iyupratis:

“Awe kew due!7 Kene niyu balabahi ka peggimu te seini se timplu te Manama. Balahara niyu re due ka gubirnadur wey ka me igbuyag te me Hudiyu ne egbalew-balew egpasasindeg te timplu te Manama diye te natahuan ded dengan kayi. 8 Timul pad due, egsuhu a kaniyu ne bulihi niyu ka me igbuyag te me Hudiyu te pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu te Manama wey kene niyu lamlamuwi ka pegbayad kandan. Ne diye egpuun te me buhis ne nalimud te prubinsya ne diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis ka igbayad kandan, eyew kene egkaangge ka himu. 9 Ne minsan nekey ne egkeilanganen te me talagpanubad diye te Hirusalim, iling te me turu ne nati ne baka, me turu ne karniru, wey ke nati ne karniru, eyew igmanubad diye te Manama ne diye te langit, wey ke trigu naa, asin, binu, wey lana, keilangan ne aldew-aldew ka pegbehey kandan, 10 su eyew egpakapanubad sikandan te igkahale te Manama ne diye te langit, wey ig-ampu dan ka umul ku wey ka me anak ku ne lukes. 11 Egsuhu a degma ne ke due etew ne egsupak te seini ne suhu, eglagnuten ka kayu ne intangen diye te baley rin wey igsundang seini kandin, wey egdereetan e ka baley rin. 12 Eglegparan perem te Manama ne iyan mig-alam te Hirusalim isip sabeka ne inged ne egsimbaan kandin, ka minsan hentew ne Hari wey ke keet-etawan naa ne eg-uney-uney egsupak te seini ne suhu, wey ke egguhus naa te timplu te Manama ne diye te Hirusalim. Sikeddiey si Daryu ka migsuhu kayi, keilangan ne egtumanen iya seini.”

“Leave them alone!7 Don't(pl) block the making of this temple of God. Ignore(pl) the governor and the elders of the Hudiyus that are redoing building the temple of God where it_was_placed before. 8 Adding to that, I command you(pl) that you(pl) help the elders of the Hudiyus in redoing building the temple of God and don't(pl) be_slow in paying them. And the payment for them comes_from the taxes collected in the province on the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River, so_that the work isn't delayed. 9 And whatever (are) the needs of the sacrificers there in Hirusalim, like male cow calves, male sheep, or sheep lamb(s), that will_be_sacrificed to the God there in heaven/sky, or wheat, salt, wine, or body_oil, it's_necessary that the giving to them is every_day, 10 so_that they can_sacrifice to please the God there in heaven/sky, and they (can) pray_for my life and my male children. 11 I also command that if there_is a person who disobeys this command, the wood that's attached to his house will_rip_out and he will_stabbed with it, and his house will_be_destroyed. 12 Hopefully God who is the one choosing Hirusalim as one place where_ he _be_worshiped will_punish, whoever King or people who takes_upon_himself to disobey this command, or destroy the temple of God there in Hirusalim. I am Daryu the (one who) commanded it, this indeed should be obeyed.”

Ka peghalad te timplu

The dedication/offering of the temple

13 Ne intuman iya ka suhu ni Hari Daryu enni Tatinay ne gubirnadur te prubinsya diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, ni Sitarbusinay, wey te me duma ran. 14 [xra][xrb]Sikan naa ka migpabulus ka pegbalew-balew pegpasasindeg te timplu wey miglampus ka me igbuyag te me Hudiyu tenged te pegbagget ni prupita Hagiyu wey ni prupita Sakariyas ne anak ni Idu. Neimpusan dan te egbalew-balew te egpasasindeg ka timplu sumale te suhu te Manama te Israil wey te balaud te me Hari te Pirsya ne ensi Siru, si Daryu, wey si Artasirsis. 15 Neimpusan ka timplu te igkatelu ne aldew te igkasapulu wey daruwa ne bulan ne iyan ka Adar, te igkeen-em ne leg-un te peghari ni Daryu.

13 And the command of King Daryu was obeyed by Tatinay the governor of the province there in the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River, by Sitarbusinay, and by their companions. 14 [xra][xrb]So then the redoing building of the temple continued and the elders of the Hudiyus were_successful because of the encouragement of the prophet Hagiyu and of prophet Sakariyas the child of Idu. They finished redoing building the temple according to the command of the God of Israil and of the law of the kings of Pirsya who were Siru, Daryu, and Artasirsis. 15 The temple was_finished on the third day of the twelfth month which is Adar, on the sixth year of the kinging by Daryu.

16 Ne miggale-gale te pegsahakeen te peghalad te timplu te Manama ka me Israilita, duma te me talagpanubad, me Libita, wey te duma ran ne nekeuli puun te pegkarakep. 17 Te seini ne peghalad te timplu, migpanubad sikandan te sabeka ne gatus (100) ne turu ne nati ne me baka, daruwa ne gatus (200) ne turu ne me karniru, wey hep-at ne gatus (400) ne nati ne me karniru. Migbehey degma sikandan te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne turu ne me kambing isip igmanubad te peglinis te sale te me Israilita sumale te kasuluhan te tribu te Israil. 18 Inteil ran degma ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita para te pegpamakey te timplu te Manama diye te Hirusalim, sumale te nasulat te libru ni Muwisis.

16 And the Israilitas, along_with the sacrificers, the Libitas, and their companions those who returned_home who were_captured before joyed in feasting in dedicating/offering the temple of God. 17 For this dedicating of the temple, they sacrificed one hundred (100) male calves of cows, two hundred (200) male sheep, and four hundred (400) sheep lambs. They also gave twelve (12) male goats as a burnt_offering(pl) for the sin of the Israilitas according to the count of the tribe(s) of Israil. 18 They also organized the sacrificers and the Libitas for serving in the temple of God there in Hirusalim, according to what_was_written in the book by Muwisis.

Ka Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan

The feast of the Passing_by of the Angel

19 [xr]Te igkasapulu wey hep-at (14) ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan te egsinundul ne leg-un, migsahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan ka nekeuli puun te pegkarakep. 20 Immatulus te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita ka pegkeetew ran wey migmalinis e sikandan langun diye te tangkaan te Manama. Sikan naa, miglape sikandan te nati ne me karniru te Pegsahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan para te langun ne nekeuli puun te pegkarakep, wey para te duma ran ne me talagpanubad, wey para te pegkeetew ran. 21 Ingkeen seini te me Israilita ne nekeuli puun te pegkarakep, duma te langun ne ware mig-apil-apil te mareet ne hinimuwan te keet-etawan ne ware migpalintutuu te Manama. In-engkeran dan e ka seeye ne me himu eyew egpamakey e te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil. 22 Nahale amana sikandan te Sahakeen te Paan ne ware Patulin seled te pitu ne aldew. Impahale sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama pinaahi te pegbalew-balew rin te suman-suman te Hari te Asirya[fn] eyew egbulihan sikandan te Hari te peggimu te timplu te Manama, ka Manama te Israil.

19 [xr]On the fourteenth (14) day of the first month of the following year, the (ones who) had_returned_home from being_captured feasted of the Passing of the Angel. 20 The sacrificers and the Libitas made_ them selves _holy and they were_ all _cleaned there in front of God. So then, they butchered sheep lambs for the Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel for all the (ones who) had_returned_home from being_captured, and for their companion sacrificers, and for them selves. 21 This was eaten by the Israilitas who had_returned_home from being_captured, along_with all didn't include (themselves) in the dirty actions of the people that don't believe in God. They left_behind these acts in_order to serve the Lord God, the God of Israil. 22 They were_ very _happy at the Feast of Bread without Riser for (LIT inside) seven days. They were_made_happy by the Lord God by_means of his changing the thinking of the king of Asiriya[fn] so_that they would_be_helped by the king in making the temple of God, the God of Israil.

Ka pegginguma ni Isra te Hirusalim

The arrival of Isra in Hirusalim

71 Peglihad te me leg-un, te peghari ni Artasirsis te Pirsya, due sabeka ne etew ne egngaranan ki Isra. Anak sikandin ni Sirayas, ne anak ni Asariyas ne anak ni Hilkiyas, 2 ne anak ni Salum ne anak ni Saduk, ne anak ni Ahitub, 3 ne anak ni Amariyas, ne anak ni Asariyas ne anak ni Mirayut, 4 ne anak ni Sirahiyas, ne anak ni Usi, ne anak ni Buki, 5 ne anak ni Abisuwa, ne anak ni Pinihas, ne anak ni Iliyasar, ne anak ni Aarun, ka Labew ne Talagpanubad.

71 After years had_passed, during the kinging by Artasirsis in Pirsya, there_was one person named Isra. He was a child of Sirayas, child of Asariyas child of Hilkiyas, 2 child of Salum child of Saduk, child of Ahitub, 3 child of Amariyas, child of Asariyas child of Mirayut, 4 child of Sirahiyas, child of Usi, child of Buki, 5 child of Abisua, child of Pinihas, child of Iliyasar, child of Aarun, the Prominent Sacrificer.

6 Seini si Isra, mig-uli diye te Hirusalim puun te Babilunya. Mangngateu sikandin ne talagpanulu te Balaud ni Muwisis, ka Balaud ne imbehey te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te Israil. Ne imbehey te Hari ka langun ne imbuyu din, tenged su inlapihan sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, ne Manama rin. 7 Te igkapitu ne leg-un te pegmandu ni Hari Artasirsis, due me Israilita ne nanguli duma ki Isra, duma te me talagpanubad, me Libita, me mangngulahing, me talagtameng te gumawan te timplu, wey me suluhuanen diye te timplu. 8-9 Migligkat si Isra puun te Babilunya te an-anayan ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan. Ne tenged su imbulihan sikandin te Manama, migginguma sikandin te Hirusalim te an-anayan ne aldew te igkalimma ne bulan, te igkapitu ne leg-un te peghari ni Artasirsis. 10 Amana egkeupian si Isra ne egnengneng te Balaud te Magbebaye ne Manama, egtuman kayi, wey egpanulu te me suhu din wey te me balaud diye te me Israilita.

6 This Isra, returned_home from Babilunya. He was a skilled teacher of the Law of Muwisis, the Law that was_given by the Lord God, the God of Israil. And the king gave everything that he requested, because he was_favored_by the Lord God, who is his God. 7 In the seventh year of the reigning of King Artasirsis, there were (some of the) people of Israil who returned_home(pl) along_with Isra, along_with sacrificers, Libitas, singers, guards of the doorway of the temple, and servants of the temple. 8-9 Isra departed from Babilunya on the first day of the first month. And because he was_helped_by God, he arrived there in Hirusalim on the first day of the fifth month, in the seventh year of the kinging by Artasirsis. 10 Isra really wanted to know the Law of the Lord God, obey it, and to_teach its commands and laws there to the Israilitas.

Ka sulat ni Hari Artasirsis ki Isra

The letter by King Artasirsis to Isra

11 Seini ka sulat ne imbehey ni Hari Artasirsis ki Isra ne talagpanubad wey talagpanulu, ka etew ne mangngateu te me balaud wey me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama para te me Israilita. Miggenendue ka sulat:

11 This is the letter that was_given by King Artasirsis to Isra the sacrificer and teacher, the person who was_skilled in the laws and commands of the Lord God for Israil. The letter goes:

12 “Ka seini ne sulat, egpuun ki Artasirsis, ka Hari te me Hari, peendiye ki Isra, ka talagpanubad wey talagpanulu te Balaud te Manama ne diye te langit:

12 “This letter, is_coming from Artasirsis, the king of kings, to Isra, the sacrificer and teacher of the Law of the God there in heaven/sky:

13 “Ne kuntee, egsuhu a ne ka minsan hentew ne Israilita kayi te migharian ku, lagkes ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita, ne egkeupian ne egduma keykew diye te Hirusalim, egkaayun e ne egduma. 14 Sikeddiey wey ka pitu ne talagtambag ku, egsuhu keykew eyew te peg-ugsi-ugsi diye te Huda wey te Hirusalim ke intuman dan naa ka me balaud ne imbehey keykew te Manama nu. 15 Ne uyana nu degma ka me pelata wey me bulawan ne igdasag ney diye te Manama te Israil ne mig-ugpe te Hirusalim, 16 duma te langun ne pelata wey bulawan ne egkalimud nu puun te prubinsya te Babilunya, wey ka me dasag te me Israilita, wey te me talagpanubad, para te timplu te Manama ran diye te Hirusalim.

13 “And now, I command whoever is from_Israil in my kingdom, including the sacrificers and the Libitas, who wants to accompany you(sg) to Hirusalim, it's allowable to accompany. 14 I and my seven advisors, command you(sg) in_order for investigating there in Huda and in Hirusalim if they are obeying the laws that were_given to you(sg) by your(sg) God. 15 And also take(sg) silver(pl) and gold(pl) that we(excl) will_give to the God of Israil who lives in Hirusalim, 16 along_with all the silver and gold to be collected by_you(sg) in the province of Babilunya, and the gifts of the Israilitas, and of the sacrificers, for the temple of their God in Hirusalim.

17 “Ilehet-lehet nu ibeli ka seini ne seleppi te turu ne me baka, turu ne me karniru, wey nati ne me karniru, duma te me halad ne egkakeen wey egkeinum. Imanubad nu ka me ayam diye te altar te timplu te Manama nu ne diye te Hirusalim. 18 Ne ka nenasame ne bulawan wey pelata, kaayun ne eggamiten nu wey te duma nu, te minsan nekey ne meupiya ne egkahamitan ne igkeupii te Manama niyu. 19 Piru uyana nu diye te tangkaan te Manama te Hirusalim ka langun ne kasangkapan ne impiyal keykew ne egkaayun ne eggamiten te pegsimba diye te timplu te Manama nu. 20 Ne emun ke duen pad minsan nekey ne egkeilanganen para te timplu te Manama nu, egkaayun ne egkuwa ka te seleppi diye te talaggen-gen te seleppi te Hari.

17 “Be_sure(sg) to spend this money on male cows, male sheep, and lambs of sheep, along_with food offerings and drinks. Sacrifice(sg) the domestic_animals at the altar of the temple of your(sg) God there in Hirusalim. 18 And the remaining gold and silver, it's_possible for you(sg) and your(sg) companions to use, for whatever good works that are desired by your(pl) God. 19 But take(sg) to the front of God in Hirusalim all the utensils that_were entrusted to_you(sg) to use for worshiping in the temple of your(sg) God. 20 And if there's anything that's needed for the temple of your(sg) God, it's_possible for you(sg) to take money there from the holder of money of the king.

21 “Ne kuntee, sikeddiey si Hari Artasirsis, migsuhu kaniyu te langun ne talaggen-gen te seleppi te prubinsya ne diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis: Ne keilangan ne igbehey niyu ka minsan nekey ne egbuyuen kaniyu ni Isra ne talagpanubad wey talagpanulu te Balaud te Manama ne diye te langit. 22 Ne ibehey niyu kandin taman te tatelu ne libu wey hep-at ne gatus (3,400) ne kilu ne pelata, daruwa ne gatus (200) ne saku te trigu, 550 ne gelun ne binu, 550 ne gelun ne mentika te ulibu, wey asin ne minsan mamenu karakel. 23 Ne himuwa niyu ka minsan nekey ne igpeyimu te Manama ne diye te langit para te timplu rin, eyew kene din igkabelu ka intiru ne migharian ku wey ka me anak ku ne lukes ne egsubal eghari keddi. 24 Ne egpanengnengen ku sikaniyu ne ware katenged niyu ne egsukut te buhis te me talagpanubad, te me Libita, te mangngulahing, te me talagtameng te gumawan te timplu, te me suluhuanen te timplu wey te duma pad ne miggimu te seini se timplu te Manama.

21 “An now, I King Artasirsis, command all you(pl) holders of money there in the province there on the opposite_bank of Iyupratis River: It's_necessary that you(pl) give whatever Isra the sacrificer and teacher of the Law of God there in heaven/sky requests from_you(pl). 22 And give(pl) him up to three thousand four hundred (3,400) kilograms of silver, two hundred (200) sacks of wheat, 550 gallon_containers of wine, 550 gallon_containers of olive cooking_oil, and however much salt. 23 And make/do(pl) whatever the God there in heaven/sky requests_done/made for his temple, so_that he won't be angry at my entire kingdom or my male children who replace me in reigning. 24 And you(pl) are informed by me that you(pl) have_no authority to charge tax from sacrificers, Libitas, singers, watchers of the doorway of the temple, servants of the temple or others who work in this temple of God.

25 “Ne sikeykew, Isra, sumale te katagseb ne naangken nu puun te Manama nu, alam ka te me talewukum eyew iyan eggukum te langun ne etew te prubinsya ne diye te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis ne nakanengneng te Balaud te Manama nu. Ne panulua nu ka minsan hentew ne ware nakanengneng kayi. 26 Ne ka minsan hentew ne kene egtuman te Balaud te Manama nu wey te balaud te Hari, due-rue ne egdusaan sikandin. Ne egkaayun ne eggimatayan sikandin wey ke egpaaween naa te inged din, wey ke eg-ahawan naa sikandin te karatuan din, wey ke egprisuwen naa.”

25 “And you(sg), Isra, according to the wisdom that you(sg) have_received from your(sg) God, choose(sg) judges so_that they will_judge all the people of the province there on the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River who know the Law of your(sg) God. And teach(sg) whoever doesn't know this. 26 And whoever doesn't obey the Law of your(sg) God and the law of the king, he (should) be immediately punished. Then_it's_possible that he be_killed or sent_away from his place, or have his wealth removed, or imprisoned.”

Ka pegdayan ni Isra te Manama

The praising of God by Isra

27 Ne migkahi si Isra, “Egdayanen ka Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te kaap-apuan ta, ne iyan migpuwas te suman-suman te Hari te pegpeupiya te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Hirusalim. 28 Ne tenged te geyinawa ne kene egkabalbalawan te Magbebaye ne Manama keddi, in-upianan a te Hari wey te me talagtambag din, lagkes ka me maddesen ne me upisyal rin. Ne tenged te peglapig man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama, nakaangken a te kabulut te peglibulung te me pangulu te me Israilita ne egduma keddi diye te Hirusalim.”

27 And Isra said, “Praise the Lord God, the God of our(incl) ancestors, who opening the thinking of the king for making_good the temple of the Lord God there in Hirusalim. 28 And due to the unchangeable love of the Lord God to_me, I was looked_after_well by the king and by his advisors, including his powerful officials. And due to the favoring again by the Lord God, I received boldness for gathering the leaders of Israilitas to accompany me to Hirusalim.”

Ka keet-etawan ne nekeuli puun te pegkarakep

The people who returned(pl) from being_captured

81 Ne seini ka me pangulu te me pamilya wey ka nenallista duma kandan ne mig-uli duma keddi puun te Babilunya te timpu ne si Artasirsis ka Hari:

81 And these (are) the leaders of families and the (ones)_listed with them that returned_home with me from Babilunya in the time of Artasirsis the king:

2 Si Hirsum,[fn] ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Pinihas; si Danyil, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Itamar; si Hatus ne anak ni Sikaniyas, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Dabid; 3 si Sakariyas, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Parus wey ka sabeka ne gatus wey lalimma ne pulu (150) ne me lukes ne nalista duma kandin.

2 Hirsum,[fn] from the descendants of Pinihas; Danyil, from the descendants of Itamar; Hatus the child of Sikaniyas, from the descendants of Dabid; 3 Sakariyas, from the descendants of Parus and the one hundred and fifty (150) men who were_listed together_with him.

4 Si Iliyuhinay ne anak ni Sirayas, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Pahatmuwab duma te daruwa ne gatus (200) ne me lukes.

4 Iliyuhinay the child of Sirayas, from the descendants of Pahatmuwab along_with two hundred (200) males.

5 Si Sikaniyas ne anak ni Dihasil, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Satu[fn] duma te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne me lukes.

5 Sikaniyas the child of Dihasil, from the descendants of Satu[fn] with three hundred (300) males.

6 Si Ibid ne anak ni Diyunatan, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Adin duma te lalimma ne pulu (50) ne me lukes.

6 Ibid the child of Diyunatan, from the descendants of Adin with fifty (50) males.

7 Si Hisayas ne anak ni Ataliya, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Ilam duma te pitu ne pulu ne (70) ne me lukes.

7 Hisayas the child of Ataliya, from the descendants of Ilam with seventy (70) males.

8 Si Sibadiyas ne anak ni Maykil, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Sipatiyas duma te walu ne pulu (80) ne me lukes.

8 Sibadiyas the child of Maykil, from the descendants of Sipatiyas with eighty (80) males.

9 Si Ubadiyas ne anak ni Hihil, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Huwab, duma te 218 ne me lukes.

9 Ubadiyas child of Hihil, from the descendants of Huwab, with 218 males.

10 Si Silumit ne anak ni Husipiyas, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Bani,[fn] duma te 160 ne me lukes.

10 Silumit child of Husipiyas, from the descendants of Bani,[fn] with 160 males.

11 Si Sakariyas ne anak ni Bibay, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Bibay, duma te daruwa ne pulu wey walu (28) ne me lukes.

11 Sakariyas child of Bibay, from the descendants of Bibay, with twenty eight (28) males.

12 Si Diyuhanan ne anak ni Hakatan, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Asgad, duma te 110 ne me lukes.

12 Diyuhanan child of Hakatan, from the descendants of Asgad, with 110 males.

13 Ensi Ilipilit, si Hiyuwil wey si Simaya, ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Adunikam, ka namewuriyan ne migginguma, duma te hen-em ne pulu (60) ne me lukes.

13 Ilipit, Hiyuwil and Simaya, from the descendants of Adunikam, were_later in arriving, with sixty (60) males.

14 Ensi Utay wey si Sakur, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Bigbay, duma te pitu ne pulu (70) ne me lukes.

14 Utay and Sakur, from the descendants of Bigbay, with seventy (70) males.

Ka peg-alam ni Isra te me Libita para te timplu

The choosing by Isra of Libitas for the temple

15 Ne inlibulung ku diye te weyig ne migpeendiye te Ahaba seeye se langun ne egduma keddi wey migkekampu key diye seled te tatelu ne aldew. Te pegpitew ku te listaan te me etew wey te me talagpanubad, ware nakita ku diye ne me Libita. 16 Ne impeumew ku ka me pangulu ne ensi Ilisir, si Aryil, si Simaya, si Ilnatan, si Harib, si Ilnatan, si Natan, si Sakariyas, wey si Misulam, wey ka me talagpanulu ne ensi Huwiyarib wey Ilnatan, 17 wey impeendiye ku sikandan ki Idu, ka pangulu te inged te Kasipiya. Impanulu ku sikandan te iglalag dan ki Idu wey te me karumaan din ne me suluhuanen te timplu su eyew egpeuyanan key te me suluhuanen ne eggimu te me himu te timplu te Manama ney. 18 Tenged te keyid-u te Manama kanami, impeuyan dan kanami ka mangngateu ne etew ne si Siribiyas, duma te sapulu wey walu (18) ne me anak din wey me karumaan din ne me lukes. Egpuun si Siribiyas te me kabuhalan ni Mali ne apu ni Libi, ne anak ni Israil.[fn] 19 Impeuyan dan degma si Hasabiyas duma ki Hisayas, ne puun te me kabuhalan ni Mirari, wey duma rin ka daruwa ne pulu (20) ne me karumaan din wey anak din ne me lukes. 20 Migpeuyan pad man-e sikandan te daruwa ne gatus wey daruwa ne pulu (220) ne me suluhuanen te timplu ne nalista ka langun ne ngaran dan. Ka me suluhuanen te timplu, inggimu dengan ni Hari Dabid wey te me upisyal rin eyew te pegbulig te me Libita.

15 And I gathered all those who had accompanied me at the river/water that goes_towards Ahaba and we(excl) camped there for (LIT inside) three days. On my looking at the list of the people and of the sacrificers, I didn't find (any) Libitas there. 16 And I had_ the leaders _called_for who were Ilisir, Aryil, Simaya, Ilnatan, Harib, Ilnatan, Natan, Sakariyas, and Misulam, and the teachers who were Huwiyarib and Ilnatan, 17 and I sent them to Idu, the leader of the village/place of Kasipiya. I taught them what_ they _would_say to Idu and to his relatives who were the servants in the temple so_that we(excl) would_be_sent servants who would do work in the temple of our(excl) God. 18 Due to the mercy of God to_us(excl), they sent us(excl) the skilled person Siribiyas, along_with eighteen (18) of his children and his relatives that were male. Siribiyas was from the descendants of Mali the grandchild of Libi, child of Israil.[fn] 19 They also sent Hasabiyas along_with Hisayas, from the descendants of Mirari, and with him twenty (20) of his relatives and his male children. 20 They also sent two hundred and twenty (220) servants of the temple whose names were_ all _listed. The servants of the temple, were_made before by King Dabid and by his officials in_order for helping the Libitas.

Ka pegpuasa wey peg-ampu enni Isra

The fasting and praying of Isra and_company

21 Ne diye te ilis te weyig te Ahaba, migsuhu a ne egpuasa su keilangan ne egpariralem key te pegkeetew ney diye te tangkaan te Manama wey eghangyu ne meupiya ka peggipanew ney, te me anak ney, duma te me karatuan ney. 22 Su neyilew a ne eghangyu te Hari te me sundalu rin wey te egmangudde eyew egbantey kanami puun te me kuntere ney diye te deralanen, su inlalahan ney ka Hari ne egpangabang ka Manama te langun ne egsalig kandin piru eglegparan din ka langun ne eg-engked kandin. 23 Sikan naa ka migpuasa key wey migpeyimmimenew te Manama ney ne egbantayan key, wey intabak din ka me peg-ampu ney.

21 And there at the edge of the River Ahaba, I commanded to fast for it was necessary that we(excl) humble our(excl) selves there in front of God and request good traveling for us(excl), for our(excl) children, along_with our(excl) wealth. 22 Because I was_ashamed to request his soldiers from the king and (those)_riding_horses in_order to guard us(excl) from our(excl) enemies on the trails, because we(excl) had told the king that God helps all who trust him but he punishes all who leave him. 23 So them we(excl) fasted and begged_compassion from our(excl) God that we(excl) be_guarded, and he answered our(excl) prayers.

Ka me dasag para te timplu

The gifts for the temple

24 Ne in-alam ku ka sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne talagpanubad ne migmangulu duma engki Sarabiyas, ki Hasabiyas wey ka sapulu (10) te me karumaan dan ne me lukes. 25 Ne imbehey ku diye te kandan ka pelata, bulawan, me kasangkapan ne indasag te Hari, te me talagtambag din, te me upisyal rin, wey te langun ne Israilita para te timplu te Manama ney. 26 Intimbang ku wey imbehey kandan ka daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa ne libu (22,000) ne kilu ne pelata, wey tatelu ne libu wey hep-at ne gatus (3,400) ne kilu ne kasangkapan ne pelata, wey tatelu ne libu wey hep-at ne gatus (3,400) ne kilu ne bulawan, 27 daruwa ne pulu (20) ne yahung ne bulawan ne walu ne kilu se kabehat langun, wey daruwa ne yahung ne burunsi ne iling ded ka bali te bulawan.

24 And I chose twelve (12) sacrificers who led along_with Sarabiyas, Hasabiyas and ten (10) if their male relatives. 25 And I gave to them the silver, gold, utensils gifted by the king, by his advisors, by his officials, and by all Israilitas for the temple of our(incl) God. 26 I weighed and gave to_them the twenty-two thousand (22,000) kilograms of silver, and three thousand four hundred (3,400) kilograms of silver utensils, and thee thousand and four hundred (3,400) kilograms of gold, 27 twenty (20) gold bowls that were eight kilograms in weight total (LIT all), and two bronze bowls of the same value as gold.

28 Ne ingkahiyan ku sikandan, “Sikaniyu wey ka seini se me kasangkapan inlein e para te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne ka pelata wey bulawan ne igdasag diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, ka Manama te kaap-apuan niyu, 29 bantayi niyu wey itines niyu seini diye te seled te sinabeng te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Hirusalim taman te egkatimbang niyu seini diye te tangkaan te me pangulu te me talagpanubad, te me Libita, wey te me pangulu te me Israilita.” 30 Sika naa, in-uyan te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita ka natimbang e ne pelata wey bulawan, wey me kasangkapan eyew eg-uyanen diye te timplu te Manama ney diye te Hirusalim.

28 And I told them, “You(pl) and these utensils have_been_set_aside for the Lord God. And the silver and gold that is gifted to the Lord God, the God of your(pl) ancestors, 29 guard(pl) (it) and store (it) there inside the room of the temple of the Lord God there in Hirusalim until (it) can_be_weighed by_you(pl) in front of the leaders of the sacrificers, of the Libitas, and of the leaders of the Israilitas.” 30 So then, the sacrificers and the Libitas took the weighed silver and gold, and utensils in_order to take (them) to the temple of our(excl) God there in Hirusalim.

Ka peg-uli diye te Hirusalim

The returning_home to Hirusalim

31 Ne migligkat key te igkasapulu wey daruwa (12) ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan puun te Weyig te Ahaba peendiye te Hirusalim. Ne migpangabang kanami ka Manama wey impariyu key nikandin puun te me kuntere ney wey puun te egmanggepas diye te dalan. 32 Te nekeuma key e te Hirusalim, miggimeley key pad diye te tatelu ne aldew. 33 Te igkeep-at ne aldew, intimbang ney e diye te seled te timplu te Manama ney ka pelata wey bulawan wey ka me kasangkapan ney, wey impiyal ney e seini ki Mirimut ne anak ni Uriyas, ka talagpanubad. Ne iyan din duma si Iliyasar ne anak ni Pinihas, wey ka me Libita ne si Husabad ne anak ni Hiswi, wey si Nuwadiyas ne anak ni Binuy. 34 Ne inseel ka langun wey intimbang, wey inlista ka langun ne kabehat.

31 And we(excl) left on the twelfth (12) day of the first month from the River Ahaba towards Hirusalim. And God helps on_us(excl) and we(excl) were_kept_far by_him from our(excl) enemies and from hold_up-ers on the way. 32 When we(excl) arrived at Hirusalim, we(excl) rested there for three days. 33 On the fourth day, we(excl) weighed there inside the temple of our(excl) God the silver and gold and our(excl) utensils, and we(excl) entrusted this to Mirimut the child of Uriyas, the sacrificer. And his companions were Iliyasar child of Pinihas, and the Libitas Husabad child of Hiswi, and Nuwadiya child of Binuy. 34 And everything was counted and weighed, and the weight of everything was listed.

35 Ne nataman, ka nekeuli puun te pegkarakep, migbehey te igmanubad diye te Manama te Israil. Ne migpanubad sikandan te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne turu ne baka para te langun ne Israilita, siyam ne pulu wey hen-em (96) ne turu ne karniru, wey pitu ne pulu wey pitu (77) ne nati te karniru. Ne migpanubad man-e sikandan te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne lukesan ne kambing para te me sale dan. Intutung seini langun isip igpanubad diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. 36 Ne imbehey ran degma ka insulat te Hari ne suhu diye te labew ne me upisyal wey diye te me gubirnadur te prubinsya ne kayi te talipag te Weyig ne Iyupratis, wey imbulihan te seini ne me pangulu ka me etew wey ka timplu te Manama.

35 And then, the (ones who) returned_home from being_captured, gave sacrifices to the God of Israil. And they sacrificed twelve (12) male cows for all the Israilitas, ninety six (96) male sheep, and seventy seven (77) lambs of sheep. And they also sacrificed twelve (12) male goats for their sins. This all was_burnt as a sacrifice to the Lord God. 36 And they also gave what_ the king _had_written (as a) command to the high officials and to governors of the province here in the opposite_bank of the Iyupratis River, and the people and the temple of God were_helped by these leaders.

Ka peglungku ni Isra te pegkamasinupaken te me Israilita

The mourning of Isra at disobedient Israilitas

91 Pegkeimpus kayi, migparani keddiey ka me upisyal wey migkahi, “Ka me Israilita, ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita, mig-ikul te mallindit ne hinimuwan te keet-etawan ne migsimba te me diyus-diyus. Ware sikandan migpariyu te me Kanaanen, me Hitihanen, me Pirisihanen, me Hibusihanen, me Amunihanen, me Muwabihanen, me Ihiptuhanen, wey me Amurihanen. 2 Ne migmangasawa sikandan wey ka me anak dan ne lukes te me lapu ne me malitan. Sikan naa ka nasewuhan e te lein ne keet-etawan ka keet-etawan te Manama. Ne ka seini ne pegsupak, due dakel ne kalabetan te me upisyal wey me igbuyag.” 3 Te pegkarineg ku kayi, inggisi ku ka kumbale ku wey ka hinabel ku. Ne inlagnut ku ka bulbul ku wey ka sumpe ku, wey migpinnuu a ne nasuhey. 4 Ne migparani wey migpaminnuu duma keddiey ka langun ne naaldek te lalag te Manama te Israil eyew eglungku degma meyitenged te pegkamasinupaken te nekeuli puun te pegkarakep dengan. Ne migpinnuu a ne nasuhey taman te migginguma ka marusilem ne pegpanubad.

91 When_ this _had_finished, the officials approached me and said, “The Israilitas, the sacrificers and the Libitas, imitated/followed the bad/dirty acts of people who worshiped false_gods. They didn't keep_distance from the Kanaanons, the Hitihanons, the Pirisihanons, the Hibusihanons, the Amunihanons, the Muwabihanons, Ihiptuhanons, and the Amurihanons. 2 And they and their male children married(pl) with the foreign females. That's why the people of God were_mixed with other people. And this disobedience, there_was a big involvement of officials and elders.” 3 When I heard this, I tore my shirt/clothing and my woven_clothing. And I pulled_out my hair and my beard, and I sat upset. 4 And all who were_afraid of the word of the God of Israil surrounded and sat(pl) along_with me in_order to mourn also concerning the disobedience of (those) returned from being_captured(pl) before. And I sat upset until the nightly sacrificing arrived.

Ka peg-ampu ni Isra

The prayer of Isra

5 Te timpu ne eggimuwen e ka marusilem ne pegpanubad, mig-engked a ka mig-puasa ne migsaluub te nahisi ne kumbale wey hinabel. Migpanimbuel a wey ingkayew ku ka me belad ku diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, ne Manama ku. 6 Ne migkahi a, “E Manama ku, neyilew a amana, wey kena a egpakaatu ne egleng-ag keykew tenged te hilew ku. Tenged su migtimpe e te ulu ney ka mareet ne hinimuwan ney wey nakaseked e te langit ka me sale ney. 7 Migdakel e ka sale ney puun te timpu te me kaap-apuan ney taman kuntee. Tenged te me sale ney, imbehey key e nikeykew diye te Hari te lein ne me nasud lagkes ka me Hari ney, ka me talagpanubad ney, wey impeyimatayan nu, impeuripen, impatulis, wey impeyilawan iling te neyitabu kuntee. 8 Piru kuntee, he Magbebaye ne Manama ne Manama ney, neyid-u ka kanami seled te malepet ne timpu, wey intuhutan nu ne duen ded nasame kanami, wey imbehayan key nikeykew te keupianan seled te seini se matulus ne inged. Ne imbehayan key nikeykew te egkapallateng[fn] wey imbulihan key nikeykew ne egpekeuli puun te pegkarakep. 9 Minsan te naddakep key, piru ware key engkeri nikeykew, ke kene, nasi nu ipapitew kanami ka geyinawa nu ne kene egkabalbalawan pinaahi te peglapig kanami te me Hari te Pirsya. Ne imbehayan key nikeykew te iyam ne umul eyew egkabalbalawan ney te egpasasindeg ka timplu nu, wey imbehayan key nikeykew te egkaaputan kayi te Huda wey te Hirusalim.

5 At the time of doing the evening sacrificing, I ceased (from) fasting dressed in torn shirt/clothing and woven_clothing. I kneeled and raised my arms/hands to the Lord God, my God. 6 And I said, “O my God, I'm very ashamed, and I can't respond by looking_up to you(sg) due to my shame. Because our(excl) evil actions have_risen_above our(excl) head(s) and our(excl) sins have equalled (the height of) the sky. 7 Our(excl) sin has increased from the time of our(excl) ancestors until now. Due to our(excl) sins, we(excl) were_given by_you(sg) to the king(s) of other nations including our(excl) kings, our(excl) sacrificers, and caused_to_be_killed by_you(sg), enslaved, robbed, and shamed like what_is_happening now. 8 But now, oh Lord God our(excl) God, you(sg) are merciful to us(excl) for (LIT inside) a short time, and you(sg) allow that there's a remainder of us(excl), and you(sg) give us(excl) peace inside this holy place. And we(excl) are given hope[fn] by_you(sg) and we(excl) were_helped by_you(sg) to return_home from captivity. 9 Even when we(excl) were_captured, but we(excl) weren't abandoned by_you(sg), but rather, instead you(sg) showed us(excl) your(sg) unchangeable love by_means of favoring us(excl) by the kings of Pirsya. And we(excl) were_given new life by_you(sg) so_that we(excl) could redo building your(sg) temple, and we(excl) were_given by_you(sg) a place_to_take_refuge here in Huda and in Hirusalim.

10 “E Manama ney, nekey naan e kuntee ka igkalalag ney pegkeimpus te seeye se langun ne neyitabu? Insupak ney red man-e ka me suhu nu 11 kanami pinaahi te me suluhuanen nu ne me prupita. Migkahiyan key nikandan ne ka tane ne eggendiyaan ney eyew eg-ugpaan, sabeka ne tane ne neempet te sale tenged te mallindit ne hinimuwan te keet-etawan diye wey te pegsimba ran te me diyus-diyus. 12 [xr]Ingkahiyan key man-e nikandan te kene ney igmaasawa ka me anak ney ne malitan te me anak dan ne lukes, wey ke igmaasawa ney naa ka me anak dan ne malitan te me anak ney ne me lukes. Ne kene key degma nikandan egpepamitawen te egpakameupiya wey egpakamatubung puun te me etew ne nangugpe te seeye ne inged. Keilangan ne egtumanen ney sika eyew egmaresen wey egmatubung key, wey ka sika ne katubung egkapanunud te me kabuhalan ney te ware egtamanan.

10 “O our(excl) God, what then can_ we(excl) now _say after that all that happened? We(excl) indeed disobeyed your(sg) commands 11 to_us(excl) by_means_of your(sg) servants the prophets. We(excl) were_told by_them that the land which we(excl) are_going_to in_order_to live_in, (is) a (LIT one) land which is covered by sin(s) due to the evil/dirty actions of the people there and to their worshiping of false_gods. 12 [xr]We(excl) were also told by_them not to give_ our(excl) female children _to_be_married by their male children, or choose_ their female children _to_be_married by our(excl) male children. And we(excl) also weren't to seek for goodness or prosperity from the people who live(pl) in that place. It's_necessary that we(excl) obey that so_that we(excl) will_grow_strong and prosper, and that abundance can_be_inherited by our(excl) descendants without ending.

13 “Ne kuntee inlegparan key nikeykew tenged te mareet ne hinimuwan ney wey te dakel ne sale ney. Piru maagkap de ka legpad nu kanami du te sale ne neyimu ney, wey intuhutan nu ne duen pad egkeuyag kanami. 14 Minsan pad due, insupak ney red abayi ka me suhu nu, wey migpangasawa key te me etew ne mallindit se me himu. Egkabelu ka iya kanami wey egguleen key nikeykew taman te warad egkasame kanami. 15 E Magbebaye ne Manama, ne Manama te Israil, matareng ka. Intuhutan nu ne duen pad egkeuyag kanami taman te seini ne aldew. Ne sikanami se nakasale, seini key kuntee te tangkaan nu, minsan ware perem sabeka kanami ne eleg ne egpakasasindeg kayi te tangkaan nu tenged te sale ney.”

13 “And now we(excl) are_being_punished by_you(sg) due to our(excl) evil actions and our(excl) big sin(s). But your(sg) punishment to_us(excl) is just light compared to the sin that_ we(excl) _have_done, and you(sg) allowed that there were still (some) of us(excl) living. 14 Despite of that, we(excl) again disobeyed your(sg) commands, and we(excl) married(pl) people with evil/dirty deeds. You(sg) are indeed angry at us(excl) and we(excl) will_be_annihilated until there's_no remainder of us(excl). 15 O Lord God, God of Israil, you(sg) are righteous. You(sg) allowed that there are still some of us(excl) alive until this day. And we(excl) who sinned, we(excl) (are) here in front of you(sg), even_though not one of us(excl) is [hopefully] worthy/correct to_stand here in front of you(sg) due to our(excl) sin.”

Ka peg-angken te keet-etawan te sale dan

The accepting by the people of their sin

101 Taheed te mig-ampu wey migpangguhud te sale si Isra ne migsinehew wey miglangkeb diye te egkatangkaan te timplu te Manama, due susuluhi ne Israilita ne me lukes, me malitan wey me bate ne miglingut kandin. Ne migpanaman-taman degma sikandan migpandalawit. 2 Ne si Sikaniyas ne anak ni Hihil, ne sabeka te me kabuhalan ni Ilam, migkahi ki Isra, “Kene key ne matinumanen te Manama ta su mig-asawa key te lapu ne me malitan puun te keet-etawan ne nakalingut kanta. Piru minsan pad due, duen ded egkapallateng te keet-etawan te Israil. 3 Ne kuntee, eggimu key te kasabutan diye te Manama ta ne egdeldelen ney ka me asawa ney duma te me anak ney, sumale te tambag nu wey te seeye se duma ne migtahud te me suhu te Manama ta. Eggimuwen ney seini sumale te Balaud te Manama. 4 Ne pangandam ke naa su himu nu iya ka pegnangen kanami ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen. Egbulihan ney sikeykew, purisu pakannekal ka wey himuwa nu seini.”

101 While Isra prayed and storied about sin and cried and bowing_face_to_ground there facing of the temple of God, there were very_many men, women and children from_Israil that surrounded him. And they also intensely wailed. 2 And Sikaniyas the child of Hihil, one of the descendants of Ilam, said to Isra, “We(excl) are_ not _faithful to our(incl) God because we(excl) married foreigner women from the people who surround us(incl). But even though, the people of Israil still have hope. 3 And now, we(excl) will_make an agreement with our(incl) God that we(excl) will_chase away our(excl) spouses with our(excl) children, according to your(sg) advice and of those others who respect the commands of our(incl) God. We(excl) will_do this according to the Law of God. 4 Then prepare(sg) because it's your(sg) task to tell us(excl) what is the right_thing to do. We(excl) will_help you(sg), therefore be strong(sg) and do(sg) it.”

5 Sikan naa, migsasindeg si Isra wey impasaad din ka me pangulu te me talagpanubad, ka me Libita, wey ka langun ne Israilita eyew egtumanen dan ka ingkahi ni Sikaniyas. Ne dutu, migsaad e sikandan langun. 6 Ne mig-awe e si Isra diye te tangkaan te timplu te Manama, wey miggendiyad e te sinabeng ni Hihuhanan ne anak ni Iliyasib. Taheed te diye sikandin, ware sikandin migkeen wey mig-inum te weyig, tenged su migpabulus pad sikandin ka miglungku tenged te ware migmatinumanen ka nenekeuli ne naddakep dengan.

5 So then, Isra stood and he made_ the leaders of the sacrificers, the Libitas, and all the Israilitas _promise that they would obey what_ Sikaniyas _said. And then, they all promised. 6 And Isra left the front of the temple of God, and went to the room of Hihuhanan child of Iliyasib. While he was there, he didn't eat or drink water, because he still continued mourning because the ones who had been returnees who were_captured before had_ not _been_faithful.

7 Ne impataha ka intiru ne Huda wey Hirusalim, ne keilangan ne eglibulung diye te Hirusalim seeye se langun ne nekeuli puun te pegkarakep. 8 Ne ke hentew seeye se kene egpakalepew seled te tatelu ne aldew, eg-ahawen ka langun ne karatuan din, sumale te pegbuut te me upisyal wey te me igbuyag, wey egdeldelen e sikandin puun te punduk te seeye se nekeuli puun te pegkarakep. 9 Ne miglibulung diye te Hirusalim ka langun ne lukes te Huda wey te Binhamin seled te tatelu ne aldew, wey naminnuu sikandan diye te plasa te timplu te Manama. Neyitabu seeye te igkararuwa ne pulu (20) ne aldew te igkasiyam ne bulan. Ne nangelkel amana te kaaldek ka me etew tenged te mapahetpet ne kasabutan dan, wey tenged te makeseg ne uran.

7 And entire Huda and Hirusalim were informed, that it's_necessary for all those who returned_home from captivity to gather at Hirusalim. 8 And whoever doesn't show_up inside three days, all his wealth will_be_taken, according to the will of the officials and elders, and he will_be_chased_out from the group of those who returned_home from captivity. 9 And all the males of Huda and of Binhamin gathered at there Hirusalim for (LIT inside) three days, and they sat(pl) there at the plaza of the temple of God. This happened on the twentieth (20) day of the ninth month. And the people shook greatly with fear due to their serious agreement, and due to heavy rain.

10 Ne migsasindeg si Isra ne talagpanubad wey migkahi diye te kandan, “Kene kew ne matinumanen, su te pegpangasawa niyu te me lapu ne me malitan, intimulan niyu ka sale te Israil. 11 Ne kuntee, ipangguhud niyu ka me sale niyu diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, ne Manama te kaap-apuan niyu, wey himuwa niyu ka igkeupii rin. Pariyu kew puun te keet-etawan ne nakalingut kaniyu wey puun te me asawa niyu ne lapu.”

10 And Isra the sacrificer stood and said to them, “You(pl) weren't faithful, because in your(pl) marrying of foreign women, you(pl) have_added to the sin of Israil. 11 And now, tell(pl) your(pl) sins to the Lord God, the God of your(pl) ancestors, and do(pl) what_ he _wants. Distance(pl) (yourselves) from the people that surround you(pl) and from your(pl) foreign spouses.”

12 Ne migtabak ka intiru ne punduk ne migpanguleyi te meemen, “Eleg ka! Keilangan ne eggimuwen ney ke nekey ka ingkahi nu. 13 Piru masulug ka me etew wey makeseg ka uran te seini ne timpu, sikan naa, kene key egpakaantus kayi te lihawangan. Timul pad due, ka seini ne prublima kene egkeimpusan te sabeka re ne aldew wey ke daruwa naa, tenged su masulug ney te nekeyimu te dakel ne sale. 14 Iggaat tad e kayi te Hirusalim ka me upisyal eyew iyan egpiyalan kayi. Ne egpeendiniyen de te intahahe ne timpu ka langun ne diye te me lungsud ney ne nenakaasawa te me malitan ne me lapu duma te me igbuyag wey me talewukum te tagse lungsud, taman te egkaawe e kayi te kanta ka mangune-kune ne langet te Manama.” 15 Ne iyan de migsupak kayi si Diyunatan ne anak ni Asahil wey si Hasiya ne anak ni Tikba, wey inlapihan sikandan ni Misulam, wey ni Sabitay ne Libita.

12 And the entire group answered and shouted loudly, “You(sg) are correct! We(excl) need to do what_ you(sg) _said. 13 But there are many people and the rain is hard at this time, so then, we(excl) can't persevere here outside. Adding to that, this problem can't be finished in just one day or even two (days), because we(excl) are many who did a great sin. 14 We(incl) will_leave_ the officials _behind here in Hirusalim so_that (they) can be entrusted with this. And all in our(excl) towns that married(pl) foreign women along_with the elders and the judges of each town, can come_here at a prepared time until the terrifying anger of God is removed from us(incl).” 15 And only Diyunatan child of Asahil and Hasiya child of Tikba disagreed with this, and Misulam, and Sabitay the Libita sided with them.

16 Ne intuman sika te seeye se nekeuli puun te pegkarakep. Purisu si Isra ne talagpanubad, mig-alam te me lukes ne pangulu te me pamilya te tagse kabuhalan, wey inlista langun ka me ngaran dan. Te an-anayan ne aldew te igkasapulu ne bulan, migpinnuu sikandan eyew te peg-ugsi-ugsi te prublima. 17 Ne te an-anayan ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan, neimpusan dan e ka peg-ugsi-ugsi te langun ne lukes ne migmangasawa te lapu ne me malitan.

16 And that was obeyed by those returned_home from captivity. Therefore Isra the sacrificer, chose males who were leaders of the family from each descendant, and all their names were listed. On the first day of the tenth month, they sat in_order for evaluating the problem. 17 And on the first day of the first month, they finished evaluating all the males who had married(pl) foreign women.

Ka me lukes ne nakaasawa te me lapu

The males who married foreigners

18-19 Due me talagpanubad ne nakaasawa te me lapu. Migsaad sikandan ne eg-engked te me asawa ran wey migpanubad man-e te turu ne karniru para te me sale dan. Seini sikandan: si Maasiyas, si Ilisir, si Harib, wey si Gidalyas ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Hiswi ne anak ni Husadak wey te me suled din.

18-19 There are sacrificers who married foreign_women. They promised to abandon their spouses and sacrificed also a male sheep for their sins. Here they are: Maasiyas, Ilisir, Harib, and Gidalyas from descendants of Hiswi the child of Husasak and his siblings/cousins.

20 Si Hanani wey si Sibadyas, ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Imir.

20 Hanani and Sibayas, from the descendants of Imir.

21 Si Maasiyas, si Ilyas, si Simaya, si Hihil, wey si Usiyas, ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Harim.

21 Maasiyas, Ilyas, Simaya, Hihiil, and Usiyas, from the descendants of Harim.

22 Si Iliyuwinay, si Maasiyas, si Ismail, si Nitanil, si Husabad, wey si Ilasa, ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Pasur.

22 Iliyuwinay, Maasiyas, Ismail, Nitanil, Husabad, and Ilasa, from the descendants of Pasur.

23 Ne ka egpuun te me Libita iyan ensi Husabad, si Simii, si Kilayas ne ingngaranan degma ki Kilita, si Pitahiyas, si Huda wey si Ilisir.

23 And from the Libitas were Husabad, Simii, Kilayas also named Kilita, Pitahiyas, Huda and Ilisir.

24 Puun te me mangngulahing: si Ilyasib.

24 From the singers: Ilyasib.

Puun te me talagtameng te gumawan te timplu: si Salum, si Tilim, wey si Uri.

From the guards of the doorway of the temple: Salum, Tilim, and Uru.

25 Seini man-e ka listaan te duma ne me Israilita ne nenakaasawa te me lapu:

25 This again is the list of others from_Israil who married foreigners:

Si Ramiyas, si Isiyas, si Malkiyas, si Mihamin, si Iliyasar, si Hasabiyas, wey si Binayas ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Parus.

Ramiyas, Isiyas, Malkiyas, Mihamin, Iliyasar, Hasabiyas, and Binayas from the descendants of Parus.

26 Si Mataniyas, si Sakariyas, si Hihil, si Abdi, si Hirimut, wey si Ilyas ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Ilam.

26 Mataniyas, Sakariyas, Hihiil, Abdi, Hirimut, and Ilyas from the descendants of Ilam.

27 Si Iliyuwinay, si Iliyasib, si Mataniyas, si Hirimut, si Sabad, wey si Asisa ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Satu.

27 Iliyuwinay, Iliyasib, Mataniyas, Hirimut, Sabad, and Asisa from the descendants of Satu.

28 Si Hiruhanan, si Hananiyas, si Sabay, wey si Atlay ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Bibay.

28 Hiruhanan, Hananiyas, Sabay, and Atlay from the descendants of Bibay.

29 Si Misulam, si Maluk, si Adayas, si Hasub, si Saal, wey si Hirimut ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Bani.

29 Misulam, Maluk, Adayas, Hasub, Saal, and si Hirimut from the descendants of Bani.

30 Si Adna, si Kilal, si Binayas, si Maasiyas, si Mataniyas, si Bisalil, si Binuy, wey si Manasis ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Pahatmuwab.

30 Adna, Kilal, Binayas, Maasiyas, Mataniyas, Bisalil, Binuy, and Manasis from the descendants of Pahatmuwab.

31-32 Si Ilisir, si Isiha, si Malkiyas, si Simaya, si Simyun, si Binhamin, si Maluk, wey si Simariyas ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Harim.

31-32 Ilisir, Isiha, Malkiyas, Simaya, Simyun, Binhamin, Maluk, and Simariyas from the descendants of Harim.

33 Si Matinay, si Matata, si Sabad, si Ilipilit, si Hirimay, si Manasis, wey si Simii ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Hasum.

33 Matinay, Matata, Sabad, Ilipilit, Hirimay, Manasis, and Simii from the descendants of Hasum.

34-37 Si Maaday, si Amram, si Uwil, si Binayas, si Bidiyas, si Siluhi, Baniyas, si Mirimut, si Iliyasib, si Mataniyas, si Matinay, wey si Haasu ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Bani.

34-37 Maaday, Amram, Uwil, Binayas, Bidiyas, Siluhi, Baniyas, Mirimut, Iliyasib, Mataniyas, Matinay, and Haasu from the descendants of Bani.

38-42 Si Simii, si Silimiyas, si Natan, si Adayas, si Maknadibay, si Sasay, si Saray, si Asaril, si Silimiyas, si Simariyas, si Salum, si Amariyas, wey si Husi ne egpuun te me kabuhalan enni Bani wey ni Binuy.

38-42 Simii, Silimiyas, Natan, Adayas, Maknadibay, Sasay, Saray, Asaril, Silimiyas, Simariyas, Salum, Amariyas, and Husi from the descendants of Bani and Binuy.

43 Si Hiil, si Matitiyas, si Sabad, si Sibina, si Haday, si Huwil, wey si Binayas ne egpuun te me kabuhalan ni Nibu.

43 Hiil, Matitiyas, Sabad, Sibina, Haday, Huwil, and Binayas from the descendants of Nibu.

44 Sikandan langun nenakaasawa te me lapu ne me malitan, wey ka duma kandan nenakaanak te sika ne me malitan.

44 They all had_married foreign women, and some of them had_children from/with that women.

Footnotes

1:5 Te Hibruwanen: ka lalag ne “me ulu te me amey” iyan igpasabut ka “pangulu te me kabuhalan.”

1:5 In Hibruwanon: the phrase (LIT word) “fathers heads” it means “leaders of descendants.”

1:11 Ka kasuluhan te kasangkapan ne nasulat te birsikulu 9-10 ware de migginguma te 5,400, tenged te ware nakumplitu te egsulat ka me kasangkapan.

1:11 The count of the utensil(s) written in verse(s) 9-10 don't come to 5,400, due to the writing of the utensils not being complete.

2:63 Ka Urim wey Tumim iyan ka me kasangkapan ne eggamiten te talagpanubad te pegnengneng te igkeupii te Manama, piru warad nataheyi ke egmenuwen seeye te eggamit.

2:63 The Urim and Tumim (are) the equipment that's used by sacrificers for knowing the desire of God, but it's no_longer known how they were used.

2:64-67 Sabeka seini ne ayam ne anak te lukes ne asnu wey beyan ne kudde.

2:64-67 This is a domestic_animal that's a child of a male donkey and a female horse.

3:1 Neyitabu seini te tatelu e ne bulan ka miglihad te peg-uli dan puun te Babilunya.

3:1 This happened after three months had passed from their returning_home from Babilunya.

3:3 Te Hibruwanen: “marusilem ne pegpanubad” piru egkeyitabu seini te me alas tris peendiye te alas singku te maapun.

3:3 In Hibruwanon: “night sacrifice” but this happened at three o'clock to five o'clock in the afternoon.

3:5 Te pegbunsud te iyam ne bulan, egtutung te igmanubad ka me Israilita eyew egpasalamat te Magbebaye ne Manama.

3:5 At the beginning of the new month, the Israilitas burn sacrifices in_order to thank the Lord God.

3:9 Si Hudabiyas, egngaranan ded degma ki Huda.

3:9 Hudabiyas, was also named Huda.

3:12 Migsinehew ka me buyag tenged su ka iyam ne timplu kenad ne iling karakel wey kateles te tapey ne timplu.

3:12 The old (people) cried because the new temple wasn't equal in size and beauty as the old temple.

4:14 Te Hibruwanen: migkeen key te asin te palasyu.

4:14 In Hibruwanon: we(excl) eat salt of the palace.

6:22 Hari te Asirya, iyan igpasabut se Hari te Pirsya su te seeye ne timpu, nasakup te Pirsya ka Asirya.

6:22 king of Asirya, means the king of Pirsya because at that time, Asirya was_under_the_jurisdiction of Pirsya.

8:2 Ka tagse pangulu kayi, nalagkes e ka pamilya rin.

8:2 Each leader here, his family is included.

8:5 Ka ngaran ne Satu inlagkes kayi sumale te duma ne tapey ne me peggalin (pitawa niyu degma diye te 2:8). Ware seini diye te Hibruwanen ne sinulat.

8:5 The name Satu is included here according to one old translation (see(pl) also there in 2:8). This isn't in Hibruwanon writing(s).

8:10 Ka ngaran ne Bani inlagkes kayi sumale te duma ne tapey ne me peggalin. Ware seini diye te Hibruwanen ne sinulat.

8:10 The name Bani is included here according to one old translation. This isn't in Hibruwanon writing(s).

8:18 Israil ka ngaran ne ingngaran te Manama ki Hakub.

8:18 Israil is the name that God named Hakub.

9:8 Te Hibruwanen: Impalayahan nu ka me mata ney.

9:8 In Hibruwanon: you(sg) light_up our(excl) eyes.
